headline: Salem 400+ Closing Ceremony on December 5th, a Luna coloring contest subcommittee, and wrapping up the 2026 gardening season.
summary: The committee will review old business, including mum planting, rain barrels, storage units, and the Haunted Happenings parade. It will also discuss new business, including bulbs, a Luna coloring contest subcommittee, and the Salem 400+ Closing Ceremony.
items: Introduction of new members: Natalie, Brian, Gabrian Beth
Ladies of Salem subcommittee update: Trails and Sails, membership, and documentation of committee processes
Luna Coloring Page Decorating Contest subcommittee creation
Wrapping up the 2026 gardening season, including taking signs in
